blocks.text: Reinforcement machine learning tajurbe se seekhti hai, bilkul insaan ki tarah. System ek environment (mahol) ke saath kaam karta hai, aur har action (amal) par use reward (inaam) ya penalty (saza) milti hai. Achhe inaam sahi rawaiye ko barhawa dete hain, aur system waqt ke saath behtar faisle karna seekh leta hai. Yeh tareeqa robotics aur games mein istemal hota hai. Seekhna trial and error (aazma kar, ghalti se seekh kar) se jaari rehta hai, aur maqsad zyada se zyada inaam hasil karna hai. Misalein: robot jo inaam aur saza se maze (bhool-bhulaiyan) ka rasta seekhta hai; AlphaGo jo Go game khel khel kar apni strategy behtar karta hai; autonomous (khud chalne wali) gaari jo driving ke faisle behtar karti hai; aur movie recommendation system jo users ke feedback se apni tajaweez badalta hai.

blocks.title: Rule-based systems
blocks.text: Exercise (Long Question 3) rule-based learning ka bhi zikr karti hai jo chapter mein bayan nahi hui. Rule-based systems logon ke likhe hue if-then rules par chalte hain, 6.3 ki traditional programming ki tarah; woh data se khud patterns nahi seekhte.

blocks.prompt: Har kaam ke liye kaun si qism? (a) Khareedari ki aadaton se customers ke groups banana jab koi category na di gayi ho. (b) Pichhli farokht (sales) se gharon ki qeemat ka andaza. (c) Jeetne par inaam de kar ek program ko game khelna sikhana.
blocks.explanation: (a) Unsupervised (clustering). (b) Supervised (pichhli qeematein labels hain; yeh regression hai). (c) Reinforcement (inaam aur saza).

items: Supervised: labeled data, prediction ke kaam.
Unsupervised: unlabeled data, clusters dhoondti hai.
Reinforcement: environment mein actions, inaam aur saza, trial and error.
